response: According to the analysis of the epidemiological pattern of Shigellosis in Barcelona between 1988 and 2012, there is evidence to suggest that Shigellosis is becoming an emerging sexually transmitted infection. The data shows an increased trend of Shigellosis in men who had no history of food poisoning or travel to endemic areas, indicating a change in the pattern of the disease, with its main mechanism probably being sexual transmission, predominantly among men.
